label: Crane Position Working position
para: The crane operator, having received the alert lifting notice, lowers the boom and returns to the working position, and work can resume only after the safety supervisor releases the rail locking device. If the locking device is not released, the crane cannot move.

label: Coolant pump
para: The chief engineer inspects the coolant pump and confirms damage to the pump impeller. The chief engineer requests parts supply from the shipping company operations office.

label: Early-morning minimum temperature -12 °C forecast received
para: At 10:00 p.m., the GMS receives a forecast of an early-morning minimum temperature of -12 °C from the meteorological agency forecast service. If the forecast temperature is -10 °C or less, the GMS issues the cold-wave alert mode. The GMS issues the cold-wave alert mode and sends a notification to th

label: Tunnel Traffic Open
para: When the fire is confirmed, the control operator lowers the tunnel entrance barrier and makes an evacuation guidance broadcast to drivers inside the tunnel through the emergency broadcast system. The two tasks proceed simultaneously.

label: No entry inside fire line before firebreak completion
para: Until H-1 arrives, the ground firefighting crew builds a firebreak in front of the east fire line on the village side, and before the firebreak is completed, firefighters must not enter inside the fire line.

label: Inspect pump after stop
para: The chief engineer inspects the coolant pump and confirms damage to the pump impeller. The chief engineer requests parts supply from the shipping company operations office.

label: Average wind speed below 20 m/s twice in a row
counterpart: reasons:Average wind speeds at 3:30 and 3:35 were below the threshold twice in a row
para: To predict the wind speed 30 min ahead, the TOC queries the 10-min average value of the weather observation unit every 5 min. If the average wind speed drops below 20 m/s twice in a row, the TOC is to lift the alert stage.

label: Determine average wind speed below threshold twice in a row
para: To predict the wind speed 30 min ahead, the TOC queries the 10-min average value of the weather observation unit every 5 min. If the average wind speed drops below 20 m/s twice in a row, the TOC is to lift the alert stage.

label: Situation room notice after traffic resumption
para: The control operator notifies the road corporation situation room of traffic resumption and ends the emergency broadcast.

label: Elevator stopped state
para: The disaster prevention center queries the status of the 24 elevators and identifies 3 stopped elevators. The disaster prevention center requests rescue from the elevator maintenance team and makes a guidance announcement to the trapped passengers through the emergency broadcast system.

label: Video call after inspection
para: The facilities team, on receiving the NOC's call, arrives on site, inspects the CH-2 compressor, and confirms that the overcurrent relay has tripped. The team shares the symptoms with the manufacturer's remote support center via video call and receives a diagnosis of compressor motor winding damage.

label: Access resumption and wrap-up
para: At 6:00 a.m., when the freezer room temperature recovers to -20 °C, the WMS lifts the freezer room access restriction.

label: High-wind caution stage lifted
para: If the high-wind caution stage is not lifted by 5:00 p.m., the TOC deploys the night shift 1 h early. On this day the caution stage was lifted at 4:40, so there was no early deployment of the night shift.

label: Boom return and wait for locking device release
para: The crane operator, having received the alert lifting notice, lowers the boom and returns to the working position, and work can resume only after the safety supervisor releases the rail locking device. If the locking device is not released, the crane cannot move.

label: Instantaneous wind speed measurement
para: At 2:00 p.m., when the weather observation unit measures an instantaneous wind speed of 18 m/s and transmits it to the TOC, the TOC issues the high-wind caution stage. When the instantaneous wind speed reaches 20 m/s or more, the TOC escalates to the alert stage, and at 25 m/s or more, to the work-s

label: Residents evacuated state
para: Because the predicted fire line recalculated at 2:20 p.m. has come as close as 0.9 km to the village boundary, the situation room requests resident evacuation from the town office, and the town office, together with the village head, evacuates 42 residents to the village hall.

label: Server room B average temperature Temperature 27 °C or less
para: At 2:18 a.m. CH-3 reached its rated capacity, and the average temperature fell below 25 °C at 2:30 a.m. Had the average temperature exceeded 30 °C, the operator would have started the planned shutdown procedure for the critical servers.

label: Request evacuation preparation if fire line within 1 km
para: The situation room calculates the fire line 30 min ahead with the spread prediction model, and if the predicted fire line comes within 1 km of the village boundary, it requests the town office to prepare for resident evacuation. According to the prediction, the fire line was 1.6 km away from the vil

label: Main engine No. 1 from stopped to running
para: The chief engineer replaces the impeller and test-runs main engine No. 1. If the coolant temperature stays at 80 °C or less during the test run, the chief engineer reports repair completion to the captain.

label: 2 heating boilers
para: The smart greenhouse operation system consists of a greenhouse management server (GMS), 2 heating boilers, a thermal curtain unit, 30 environmental sensors, and a nutrient solution supplier. The environmental sensors measure temperature, humidity, and CO2 concentration.

label: Refrigeration Unit 2 stopped state
para: At 2:00 a.m., when Refrigeration Unit 2 stops due to compressor overheating, the WMS detects the refrigeration unit stop and sends an alarm to the facility manager.

label: Arrive on site after call
para: The facilities team, on receiving the NOC's call, arrives on site, inspects the CH-2 compressor, and confirms that the overcurrent relay has tripped. The team shares the symptoms with the manufacturer's remote support center via video call and receives a diagnosis of compressor motor winding damage.

label: Passenger ship Operation mode Normal operation
para: At 4:00 p.m., the EMS detects a coolant temperature of 95 °C on main engine No. 1 and displays an alarm on the bridge. The captain stops main engine No. 1 and operates at reduced speed with main engine No. 2 only.

label: Situation room notice after traffic resumption
para: The control operator notifies the road corporation situation room of traffic resumption and ends the emergency broadcast.

label: No hoisting of containers stacked 2 tiers or more in alert stage
para: When the wind speed is measured at 21 m/s at 2:25 p.m., the TOC issues the alert stage and notifies the shipping agency of the possibility of cargo-handling delay. In the alert stage, containers stacked 2 tiers or more must not be hoisted.

label: Open vent on high humidity
para: If the indoor humidity is 90% or more, the cultivation manager opens the vent window for 5 min. On this day, the humidity stayed at 85%, so the vent window was not opened.

label: setpoint=23 °C
para: Since cooling must meanwhile be done with CH-1 and CH-3 only, the operator raises the setpoint temperature of server room B from 22 °C to 23 °C and establishes a contingency plan for the case where one more chiller stops.

label: Main engine No. 2 stops (hypothetical)
para: If even main engine No. 2 stops, the captain requests towing from the Coast Guard. On this day, main engine No. 2 did not stop, so towing was not requested.

label: Crane rail locking device
para: The crane operator stops work by setting down the container being held onto the nearest AGV, and moves to the standby position with the boom raised. The safety supervisor inspects the crane rail locking device and confirms its engagement state.

label: Incident closure and reporting
para: The control operator notifies the road corporation situation room of traffic resumption and ends the emergency broadcast. The tunnel control room compiles the incident record and submits it to the road corporation situation room.

label: Rail locking device release gate
para: The crane operator, having received the alert lifting notice, lowers the boom and returns to the working position, and work can resume only after the safety supervisor releases the rail locking device. If the locking device is not released, the crane cannot move.

label: Intensive monitoring (5 min interval)
para: At 1:00 p.m., the upstream dam management office notifies the central control room that it will increase the discharge rate. The central control room shortens the raw water turbidity monitoring interval from 30 min to 5 min.

label: CO concentration threshold decision
para: When the carbon monoxide concentration inside the tunnel falls below 30 ppm, the control operator raises the entrance barrier and resumes traffic.

label: Parts supply request
para: The chief engineer inspects the coolant pump and confirms damage to the pump impeller. The chief engineer requests parts supply from the shipping company operations office.

label: Humidity monitoring and ventilation check
counterpart: Indoor temperature monitoring and additional boiler operation
para: If the indoor humidity is 90% or more, the cultivation manager opens the vent window for 5 min. On this day, the humidity stayed at 85%, so the vent window was not opened.

label: Tunnel system setup and monitoring
para: The expressway tunnel management system consists of the tunnel control room, fire detectors, 12 jet fans, barriers, and an emergency broadcast system. The fire detectors monitor the temperature inside the tunnel. Outside are the fire station and the road corporation situation room; the control opera

label: Freezer room temperature measurement
para: The cold-storage logistics center operations system consists of a warehouse management system (WMS), 3 refrigeration units, 40 temperature sensors, a door controller, and an emergency generator. The temperature sensors measure the freezer room temperature every 5 min.

label: power outage duration=1 h 10 min
para: If the power outage exceeds 1 h 30 min, the facility manager notifies the tenant companies of an advisory to leave work. On this day the power outage ended after 1 h 10 min, so the advisory to leave work was not issued.

label: Crane rail locking device
para: The crane operator stops work by setting down the container being held onto the nearest AGV, and moves to the standby position with the boom raised. label: Next drop cycle
para: At 2:50 p.m., when the firebreak is completed and the spread of the east fire line stops with H-1's fifth drop, the situation room lowers the wildfire from Level 2 to Level 1. However, while residual fire remains, the helicopter is not withdrawn. H-1, having arrived at 1:58 p.m., takes on water from

label: Coolant temperature within limit during test run
para: The chief engineer replaces the impeller and test-runs main engine No. 1. If the coolant temperature stays at 80 °C or less during the test run, the chief engineer reports repair completion to the captain.

label: Measure raw water turbidity (50 NTU)
para: When the raw water quality analyzer measures a turbidity of 50 NTU and transmits it to the central control room, the central control room declares the high-turbidity response stage. If the turbidity is 100 NTU or more, the central control room temporarily suspends water intake.

label: freezer room temperature>-18 °C
para: When the freezer room temperature rises above -18 °C, the WMS restricts freezer room access through the door controller. At 3:00 a.m., when the freezer room temperature is measured at -17 °C, the WMS restricts freezer room access.

label: Alert lifting notice
para: The crane operator, having received the alert lifting notice, lowers the boom and returns to the working position, and work can resume only after the safety supervisor releases the rail locking device. If the locking device is not released, the crane cannot move.

label: High-turbidity stage lift
para: At 9:00 p.m., when the raw water turbidity drops below 30 NTU, the central control room lifts the high-turbidity response stage and returns the monitoring interval to 30 min.

label: Power usage data by floor
para: The high-rise building operation system consists of the disaster prevention center, the building energy management system (BEMS), 2 emergency generators, 24 elevators, and the emergency broadcast system. The BEMS monitors power usage by floor.

label: CH-2 compressor
para: At 2:10 a.m., when the compressor of CH-2 stops due to overcurrent, the BMS detects the CH-2 stop signal, sends an alarm to the NOC, and automatically starts CH-3, which was on standby.

label: Cold-wave protection and temperature monitoring
counterpart: Indoor temperature monitoring and additional boiler operation
para: In the cold-wave alert mode, the thermal curtain unit closes the thermal curtain, and Boiler 1 maintains the greenhouse target temperature at 15 °C. The two measures start simultaneously. At 2:00 a.m., when the environmental sensors measure an indoor temperature of 11.5 °C, the GMS operates Boiler 2

label: 300 customer servers in server room B
para: Server room B houses 300 customer servers; customer technical support is handled by the customer support team, and equipment repair by the facilities team. The chiller manufacturer's remote support center is located off-site.

label: Tunnel entrance barrier
para: When the fire is confirmed, the control operator lowers the tunnel entrance barrier and makes an evacuation guidance broadcast to drivers inside the tunnel through the emergency broadcast system. The two tasks proceed simultaneously.
